Sergio,

We observed a set of anomalous API calls that appear to have retrieved customer PII from one of our production routes between 01:20–01:32 UTC on 2026-09-12. Our engineering lead asked us to flag this immediately and request Redwood's cooperation for: (1) a short timeline for notification to impacted customers, (2) instructions for securely transferring evidence (we have logs + sample transcript), and (3) whether any Redwood subprocessors may have been involved in routing.

I've attached a CSV of the raw access rows and a small sample of affected object IDs (finserv_access_logs_0912.csv). Please confirm receipt and let us know the earliest time we can expect a named contact for evidence handoff.

Thanks,
